jobs.title: Senior Director, Sales Enablement
jobs.description:
Color is revolutionizing cancer care with the nation’s first Virtual Cancer Clinic, delivering high-quality, physician-led multidisciplinary care across all 50 states. Our innovative, guideline-based approach spans cancer screening, risk assessment, prevention, diagnosis, treatment support, and survivorship. In addition to personalized direct medical care, our services include cancer genetics risk assessment, nutrition, mental health support and at-home cancer screening diagnostics. Using technology-driven, patient-centric solutions, Color is transforming how employers, unions, health plans, and governments address cancer. Color’s goal is to close critical cancer care gaps, improve cancer outcomes, and guide patients with empathy through their healthcare journeys.

Apply to join Color and do the most meaningful work of your career. If you are not sure that you’re 100% qualified but are up for the challenge - we want you to apply!

About the Role:
We are seeking a Sr. Director of Sales Enablement to serve as a key strategic leader within our Commercial organization. In this role, you will define and execute the global enablement vision, scaling our programs to support rapid growth and ensuring our GTM teams are equipped to win in a complex marketplace.

You will drive high-level cross-functional alignment across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations, turning organizational strategy into field execution.

You'll report directly to the CRO and work closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, and Product to make sure every seller new or tenured has what they need to sell effectively.
How You'll Contribute:

 - Define the multi-year sales enablement roadmap and strategy, ensuring alignment with Color’s long-term commercial objectives and revenue goals.

 - Partner with Executive Leadership to codify and institutionalize Color’s sales methodology and "gold standard" for commercial excellence across all segments (payer, employer, and health system).

 - Build the "Color Sales Academy," ensuring a premier onboarding and ongoing development experience for our commercial team. Design and run certifications and ongoing trainings.

 - Support the selection, implementation, and optimization of a sales enablement tech stack to drive measurable productivity gains. Build out AI efficiencies that are embedded in GTM daily operations across the team.

 - Partner with Marketing to own the creation and ongoing iteration of the sales narrative, while working closely with Marketing and Executive Leadership.  Develop and maintain talk tracks, pitch decks, and core messaging, giving sales a consistent, compelling story at every stage of the deal.

 - Own go-to-market enablement for new product launches and messaging updates. Turn what Marketing and Product build into training, certifications, and field-ready materials before launch day.

 - Serve as the voice of the field. Bring real feedback from sales conversations back to Marketing and Product to sharpen messaging over time.

 - Partner with People on new hire logistics, cohort scheduling, and manager enablement, so frontline sales managers can reinforce training in the field.

 - Report on program impact to sales and commercial leadership, and evolve the curriculum as headcount, product, and go-to-market strategy shift.

 - Build out RFP content and support custom RFP responses for AEs [can be above a certain deal size]

 - Support custom seller enablement needs for major deals

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have:

 - 10+ years of leadership experience in sales enablement, revenue operations, or sales leadership, ideally within a high-growth B2B environment.

 - Proven track record of scaling sales organizations from early-stage growth to global maturity, with a focus on digital health or complex healthcare technology.

 - Demonstrated ability to influence and partner with C-suite executives and senior cross-functional leaders to drive strategic GTM initiatives.

 - Strong instructional design skills. You know how adults learn and can turn dense product or clinical information into training that sticks.

 - Confident presenting to and facilitating groups, including live virtual sessions.

 - Experience with CRM (Salesforce or similar) and sales enablement (Confluence) or LMS tools.

 - Experience building out and deploying AI tools/technologies to go-to-market teams that have a measurable impact on commercial performance

 - Data-driven. You track program impact and aren't afraid to cut what isn't working.

 - A strong cross-functional operator who builds real relationships across Sales, Marketing, Product, and People.

 - Experience partnering with Marketing on messaging, talk tracks, or pitch decks, and turning that messaging into sales training.

 - Experience leading go-to-market enablement for product launches, getting a sales team ready to sell something new, fast and credibly.

 - Self-directed and comfortable in a fast-growing remote environment where you're often building the plane while flying it.

 - Low ego

Nice to Have:

 - Experience selling into health plans, employers, or health systems specifically.

 - Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDIC, Challenger, or Command of the Message.

 - Experience standing up or running a formal sales academy or certification program.

What We Offer:

 - 💰 Competitive salary

 - ✨ Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits

 - 📈 401k match

 - 📝 Monthly phone and wifi stipend for employees, annual ergonomic stipend

 - 🏝 Generous vacation policy, paid holidays and company-wide recharge days

 - 🍼 Equal paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

 - Free cancer screening and prevention resources for employees and their adult dependents

Base Salary Range:$175,000 - $210,000/year

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: work experience, market data, skills, geographic location, and business need. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Color is revolutionizing cancer care with the nation’s first Virtual Cancer Clinic, delivering high-quality, physician-led multidisciplinary care across all 50 states. Our innovative, guideline-based approach spans cancer screening, risk assessment, prevention, diagnosis, treatment support, and survivorship. In addition to personalized direct medical care, our services include cancer genetics risk assessment, nutrition, mental health support and at-home cancer screening diagnostics. Using technology-driven, patient-centric solutions, Color is transforming how employers, unions, health plans, and governments address cancer. Color’s goal is to close critical cancer care gaps, improve cancer outcomes, and guide patients with empathy through their healthcare journeys.

Apply to join Color and do the most meaningful work of your career. If you are not sure that you’re 100% qualified but are up for the challenge - we want you to apply!

About the Role:
Color's ASCO Certified oncology care programs are designed for one of the most complex and human moments in healthcare: helping people through an active cancer diagnosis, through treatment, and through the years that follow. The Engagement Marketing team is seeking a results-driven Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take full ownership of the end-to-end experience for these members, including cancer survivors and the family members and caregivers supporting them.

This role requires someone who can hold two things at once: rigorous analytical judgment and genuine care for an audience navigating the hardest moment of their lives. You will own how these members first learn that Color can help them, how they experience their earliest interactions with our program, and how that relationship deepens over months and years. You will design across the full set of touchpoints that shape that experience, including digital, but thinking beyond digital to the creative, human spaces.

You will partner closely with our product, design, and clinical teams, working alongside Color Medical Group to ensure every touchpoint is clinically sound, appropriately timed, and worthy of the moment it meets someone in. You will also work with customer success and our commercial teams to bring this experience to employers and health plans in a way they can see and understand.

This is a data-forward role. You will be expected to answer your own questions with data rather than waiting for someone else to answer them for you.

This role reports to the Director of Engagement Marketing and offers meaningful ownership in a growing and deeply impactful area of Color's business.

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have:

 - 5+ years in lifecycle or member experience marketing, with direct ownership of enrollment or engagement performance.

 - Strong analytical fluency and comfort working independently in the data.

 - Experience designing lifecycle experiences beyond digital channels, including direct mail, printed materials, and touchpoints delivered by people rather than systems

 - Deep hands-on expertise in Braze, with the ability to build complex multi-channel journeys independently.

 - Comfort designing and interpreting experiments in small populations, where traditional testing approaches do not always apply.

 - Exceptional writing skills and the judgment to communicate with people navigating a cancer diagnosis clearly and warmly.

 - A bias toward action in ambiguous, fast-moving work. This program is still taking shape, and you will build the path as you go rather than inherit one.

 - Proven ability to move work forward with product, design, and clinical partners, including within a medical review process.

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have:

 - Experience marketing to or building programs for people managing a cancer diagnosis, a chronic condition, or another serious health situation.

 - Experience with claims-based marketing.

 - Background in behavioral science, nudge theory, or applied experimentation.

 - Experience with long-horizon programs where the relationship is measured in years and re-engagement matters as much as onboarding.

 - Comfortability with metabase and building/analyzing queries.

 - Comfortability using AI to work faster on analysis and operations.


What We Offer:

 - 💰 Competitive salary

 - ✨ Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits

 - 📈 401k match

 - 📝 Monthly phone and wifi stipend for employees, annual ergonomic stipend

 - 🏝 Generous vacation policy, paid holidays and company-wide recharge days

 - 🍼 Equal paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

 - Free cancer screening and prevention resources for employees and their adult dependents

Base Salary Range: $115,00-140,000/year

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: work experience, market data, skills, geographic location, and business need. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.description:

About the Health Plan Partnerships Team:

The Health Plan Partnerships team owns Color's relationships with its health plan, TPA, and PBM partners – the channel through which a significant and fast-growing portion of Color's business flows. The team is responsible for everything from early contracting and go-to-market strategy to Account Executive activation, RVP enablement, and ongoing partner operations.

This is a high-growth, high-visibility team. As Color brings more health plan, PBM, & TPA partners live and expands the book of business running through those partnerships, the operational and commercial demands on the team are scaling quickly. We're building the infrastructure, processes, and people to match that growth – and this role is a key part of that build.

About the Role:
Color is looking for a Health Plan Partnerships Manager to sit at the intersection of commercial growth and operations. This is a quota-carrying role with direct impact on how Color scales revenue through its health plan, PBM, and TPA partnerships.

You'll work closely with a Health Plan Partnership Director, owning day-to-day partner operations while also driving meaningful pipeline alongside Color's sales team and partner account executives, associate account executives, and clinical account managers. This role offers high visibility with leadership and a clear line of sight to commercial outcomes.
How You'll Contribute:

Sales Enablement & ASO Pull-Through (70%)

 - Own partner AE engagement strategies (partner events, trainings, 1:1 relationships) to drive growth via the ASO (self-insured) segment

 - Build network of sales champions across book of partners

 - Accountable for inbound pipeline attainment in collaboration with partner account executives at health plans, PBMs, and TPAs

 - Partner with plan AEs to ensure Color is recommended in client annual business reviews

 - Coordinate deal progression and next steps with Color RVPs

 - Ensure all open opportunities are properly tracked and maintained in Salesforce (SFDC)

 - Own development of AE and consultant training curriculum and enablement assets (playbooks, client ABR materials, objection handling guides, FAQs) for partner sales teams; lead delivery of trainings and onboarding sessions

 - Assist with partner events and conferences to deepen relationships and drive downstream pipeline (estimated 2-3x per quarter travel)

 - Own pre-event outreach strategy and post-event pipeline follow-up for 2-3 partner events/conferences per quarter

Partner Operations (30%)

 - Own the health plan partnership operating rhythm for assigned partnerships: set the recurring meeting cadence, circulate agendas, and hold internal/external stakeholders accountable for action items

 - Own the partnership plan for assigned partnerships as agreed upon with the Partnerships Director: define milestones, assign owners, track progress, and flag risks to the Director before they become escalations

 - Own internal partnership documentation and dashboards as the single source of truth on partnership status for internal stakeholders

 - Coordinate with marketing on approved asset development for assigned partners (approved member communications ensuring partner consistency, pre-sale materials, market-facing partnership materials)

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have:

 - Experience in digital health and/or healthcare consulting – you understand the space and hit the ground running

 - Familiarity with the payer landscape and how digital health solutions partner with health plans, PBMs, and TPAs

 - Experience in a quota-carrying or pipeline-owning sales, partnerships, or business development role, ideally in a channel or partner-sell-through model

 - Track record of building and running relationships with sales reps or account executives at a partner organization to drive pipeline (not just internal stakeholder management)

 - Comfortable owning a number: pipeline generation, attainment against a target, or channel revenue growth

 - Experience designing or delivering sales enablement content (training, playbooks, objection handling) and running live trainings with an external sales team

 - Hands-on Salesforce (SFDC) experience – you keep pipeline clean and use data to prioritize

 - Scrappy and creative with a strong bias toward action – you don't wait for perfect conditions to move forward

 - Comfortable operating across both operational and commercial workstreams; you're as comfortable building a reporting workflow as you are preparing for a partner QBR

 - Strong communicator who can work effectively with external partners and internal stakeholders alike

 - Willingness to travel to partner events approximately 2-3 times per quarter

What We Offer:

 - 💰 Competitive salary

 - ✨ Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits

 - 📈 401k match

 - 📝 Monthly phone and wifi stipend for employees, annual ergonomic stipend

 - 🏝 Generous vacation policy, paid holidays and company-wide recharge days

 - 🍼 Equal paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

 - Free cancer screening and prevention resources for employees and their adult dependents

Base Salary Range: $100,000 - $115,000/year. This is an incentive-eligible position with additional compensation offered as a bonus tied to goal attainment.
